review.why: Explains n8n looping: when default per-item runs are enough, when to run once, when to use Loop Over Items, and how to paginate.
review.summary: Maps three meanings of loop to three mechanisms, with the input array as the loop. Its non-negotiable is the run-once setting for aggregate nodes, which otherwise repeat for every item. It gives a decision tree, common surprises (duplicate summaries, double webhook replies, repeated model calls) and four scenarios, most of which need no loop node at all.
strengths: Corrects the common mistake of adding Loop Over Items just to wait
Run-once setting explained with a counter-case
Prefers built-in pagination to hand-built page loops
cautions: Later scenarios and two reference files are not read here
Setting names depend on n8n versions
